title: Canon threshold 70 and E9 bound 6 restated in code despite the file's own canon-derivation rule (ODN-5)
evidence: noc_queue_rows: `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || p.util_pct >= 70 {` ; draw pass: `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < 70 {` ; label: `cur = noc_section(v, cur, scroll, visible, "QUEUES VS E9 BOUND (6)")` followed by `bound := u32(max(1, cat.balance.lane_queue_packets))` — while colors correctly derive from `return noc_level(util_pct * 10, cat.balance.warnings.pipe_amber_pct, cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct)`
detail: ODN-5 says balance numbers live only in data/*.json. The row-filter hardcodes pipe_amber_pct (70) twice and the section label hardcodes lane_queue_packets (6); a balance.json tune silently desyncs row selection and label from the canon-derived bars.
recommended_fix: Pass the precomputed amber_pct (and bound) into noc_queue_rows/the draw predicate, and build the section label with fmt.tprintf from cat.balance.lane_queue_packets.

title: run-dev.sh documents a --stats-out pass-through but never forwards the collected args
evidence:
`# tools/run-dev.sh --stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag)` ; args are collected `*) ARGS+=("$1") ;;` ; the build line `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20` ; the run lines `PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev` and ` ./bin/app-dev` pass no args
detail: The documented flag is silently swallowed — exactly the wired-but-dead failure class this PR exists to kill. Additionally, with non-empty ARGS, "${ARGS[@]+}" expands to one stray empty-string argument to odin build (verified on bash 3.2).
recommended_fix: Forward args to the run, not the build: `./bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+"${ARGS[@]}"}"` (both invocations), and drop the "${ARGS[@]+}" token from the odin build line.

title: Draw-site comment says "F-key debug surface" but the shipped toggle is D
evidence: `		// v2-noc: the F-key debug surface (the merged 5.7 + NOC overlay) draws` — while the ruling made D final: poll.odin gates `if rl.IsKeyPressed(.D)` and the e2e injects `inp.Key_Press{key = .D}`
detail: The comment contradicts the key the code polls; given this PR's F-vs-D history, a maintainer reading "F-key" at the draw site is actively misled about the toggle.
recommended_fix: Reword to "D-key debug surface" in the main.odin draw-pass comment.

title: noc_row_right helper has zero call sites
evidence: `noc_row_right :: proc(v: ^View, cur, scroll, visible: i32, txt: string, size: i32, col: rl.Color, w: i32) -> i32 {` — repo-wide grep for `noc_row_right` finds only this definition and its comment (the panel right-aligns via noc_row + noc_col, 15 call sites)
detail: Unused proc in a PR whose spec mandates "one key, one panel, zero dead code"; it will rot or be cargo-culted into the next surface.
recommended_fix: Delete noc_row_right (noc_col already provides fixed right-edge alignment).

title: noc_panel_rows measure pass already diverges from draw_noc_panel row predicates
evidence: Measure: `rows += i32(min(9, len(stats.classes)))` and `if sel_pipe >= 0 { rows += 4 // section + offered + carried + drops` ; Draw: `for c in stats.classes { if shown >= 9 { break } if int(c.class) >= len(cat.packet_types) { continue }` (no row emitted) and the readout is gated `ps, ok := pp.pipe_slot(topo, u32(sel_pipe)) if ok {`
detail: The comment demands "MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row (same count predicates)" but the measure counts out-of-roster class rows and a dead sel_pipe unconditionally. Effect is benign (scroll clamp overshoots), yet the invariant is already broken and future edits widen it silently.
recommended_fix: Make noc_panel_rows take cat/topo and apply the same roster-filter and pipe_slot-ok predicates, or emit rows into a buffer so measure and draw share one pass.
